card.name: Words pointing back to past history
card.fires_on: Words that lead into something that happened earlier, such as prior, previously, previous, "history of", or "patients who" before a past event. Mostly in contraindication and warning text about earlier reactions.

modes.label: Prior or previous
modes.description: The words prior, previous or previously placed before a past reaction or event.
modes.example: unless patients have a<< previously>> documented HLA-B*570

modes.label: History of / patients who
modes.description: Linking words after "history" or "patients" that introduce an earlier event.
modes.example: In patients with a history<< of>> a clinically significant low WBC/ANC

modes.label: Narrative past reference
modes.description: A pronoun in general text that leads into something lived through in the past.
modes.example: People were still scared of the repression that<< they>> had lived under for so long, so

card.writes: It promotes words meaning "once" or "in the past" and suppresses words about sudden or unexpected events.
card.plain: It marks spots where the text is about to refer to something that happened before, like a prior reaction.
